title: LifeOS join public for new users; login separate for existing accounts
problem: https://lifeos.ecomae.com/lifeos/join redirected to /lifeos/login?returnUrl=%2Flifeos%2Fjoin — new users could not join without signing in.
fix: POST /lifeos/join allows anonymous join; optional session binds OwnerUserId
Login page copy/CTA is for existing accounts only; default redirect /lifeos not join
Chrome shows Sign in and Join as separate links

flow.newUser: Home → Join → companion/results via join token
flow.existingUser: Home → Sign in → console / account-bound surfaces

prove: curl -sI https://lifeos.ecomae.com/lifeos/join | head -15  # expect 200, not Location login
curl -sL https://lifeos.ecomae.com/lifeos/join | grep -E 'join without signing|Create your client'
curl -sL https://lifeos.ecomae.com/lifeos/login | grep -E 'existing ecomae|Go to Join'

curl -sL -X POST https://lifeos.ecomae.com/lifeos/join -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json' -d '{"displayName":"ProveUser","country":"United Arab Emirates","countryCode":"AE"}' | head

agentProbeAfterAction.loginCopy: still Sign in & continue to join

expect: RESULT=PASS — LifeOS join public / login separate
